source_snapshot_contract: Every task-owned native case independently checks the entire ordered source bag, with SQL data types fixed by source_setup; timestamps are normalized to epoch milliseconds and floating values preserve signed-zero text.
control_direction_contract: N-labelled cases include counterfactual vendor-law controls and SQL NOT TRUE/rollback negatives; N does not automatically imply a rejected Boolean witness.
